dedupe_keys.name: wi fi vehicles measurement and trace analysis tools

description: Wi-Fi Vehicles publishes tools for collecting and analysing mobile wireless connectivity measurements. The research team documents passive Wi-Fi capture, GPS and channel-utilisation logging, trace manipulation and analysis of access-point selection strategies. Python modules, shell scripts and Jupyter notebooks are publicly available on GitHub under the repository’s CC BY 4.0 licence. Coverage is location-independent tooling developed around vehicle and bicycle experiments in Portugal, including 2019 traces and later 802.11ad work. The documentation marks older trace scripts deprecated and leaves some database-dependent routines incompletely described. These are limitations for unattended reuse. A reviewer-assessed use is preparing mobile-network traces or testing access-point-selection assumptions in road communications simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related simulator, without verified integration. The separately recorded 802.11ad dataset is one application of the code. No radio interface, capture command, database or notebook was executed.
name: Wi-Fi Vehicles measurement and trace-analysis tools
